description: Build an HTTP Range request-header value (RFC 7233) from one or more byte ranges: explicit start-end pairs, open-ended "start to end of file" ranges, or suffix "last N bytes" ranges. Pass totalSize to resolve open-ended/suffix byte lengths and get overlap warnings. Pure string assembly and arithmetic; never makes a network request.

ranges.description: One or more byte ranges to request

end.description: Last byte offset (inclusive); omit for "to end of file"

suffixLength.description: Request the last N bytes instead of start/end

totalSize.description: Total resource size in bytes, used to resolve open-ended/suffix ranges and detect overlap

name: build_range_header
